grammarNotes.explanation: Use elle s’appelle and elle vient de to introduce another person. Tu fits peers; vous fits a formal group or unfamiliar adult. Explain a reason with parce que. To repair an overly informal first introduction, restate the same facts with vous and a fuller greeting; do not change the facts.

model.peer: Je te présente Camille. Elle vient de Lyon.
model.formal: Je vous présente Camille, notre nouvelle camarade.
model.reason: Elle nous rejoint parce qu’elle veut pratiquer la conversation.

grammarNotes.caution: A polished introduction takes more than one turn. Keep the facts consistent as you switch between familiar and formal address.

A missing item may be absent from its expected place without being lost; verify the new location before reporting that it is gone.
